name: ContainedList

props.name: action
props.description: A slot for a possible interactive element to render.

props.name: isInset
props.description: Specify whether the dividing lines in between list items should be inset.

props.name: kind
props.description: The kind of ContainedList you want to display

props.name: label
props.description: A label describing the contained list.

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the contained list.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon ContainedList rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
